high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram post by the user "sam_fromonline." The post was made 14 hours prior to the screenshot being taken on Tuesday, May 27th at 10:30 PM. The main focus of the image is a close-up photograph of a person wearing a black hoodie with a large, pointed hood that covers most of their face. The hoodie has a zipper running down the front. The person's mouth is slightly open, and they appear to be looking directly at the camera. Overlaid on the image in bold red text is the question, "Next hood construction
